verse.text: So be strong and courageous! Do not be afraid and do not panic before them. For the LORD your God will personally go ahead of you. He will neither fail you nor abandon you.

reflection: Every dad faces moments—job pressure, tough conversations, sleepless nights—where fear whispers that he's not enough. Deuteronomy 31:6 reminds us that courage for our families isn't self-generated; it flows from knowing God goes ahead of us and never walks away. So lead today not because you feel fearless, but because you're not leading alone.
